description.narrative: Project support: Development of municipal development plans, capacity building of planners and other staff through training-on-the-job. Support to pilot investments to realize some prioritised activities (50% cost sharing). Smaller component, capacity building of the national ministry and the spatial planning institute.

Projekt stöd: Utveckling av kommunala utvecklings planer, kapacitets utveckling av planerare och andra anställda genom training-on-the-job. Stöd till pilot investerare att genomföra prioriterade aktiviteter (50% kostnadsdelning). Mindre komponent, kapacitets utveckling av the National Ministry och the Spatial Planning institute.

Four Municipal Development Plans (MDP) were drafted in-house and approved. One Urban Regulatory Plans prepared in-house and approved by the municipal assembly in support of further regulating the city center.Assessments of MDPs implementation were carried out in 3 partner municipalities, as such testing and developing assessment methodologies.MDP guidelines were prepared, a dedicated training module rolled-out throughout Kosovo within the rolling-out of MuSPP Toolbox. The module is now anchored in Kosovo Insitute of Public Aadministration (KIPA) and its delivery has been already replicated after MuSPP3 ending.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
